item.title: How to Save Money on a Low Income: Where to Actually Start
item.description: Standard savings advice assumes room in the budget that isn't always there. Here's where the real leverage is when income is tight, an honest look at cutting expenses versus growing income, and a tax credit most low-income savers don't know they qualify for.

item.title: High-Yield Savings Accounts, Explained: What They Are and How to Compare Them
item.description: A high-yield savings account pays several times the national average with no extra risk. Here's what actually separates one HYSA from another, and how to compare them without chasing a rate that changes next month.

item.title: How Much Should You Actually Have in an Emergency Fund?
item.description: The 3-6 months advice isn't wrong, but it's not the whole answer. Here's how to size an emergency fund based on your actual situation, not a generic rule.
